name: time_subtract
title: Subtraction negates the periods and calls time_add.

origin.description: Subtraction negates the periods and calls time_add.
origin.details: Subtraction negates the periods and calls time_add.
origin.example:
x <- as.POSIXct("2010-03-15 01:02:03", tz = "America/New_York")
print(unclass(time_subtract(x, hours = 22, minutes = 50, roll_dst = "post")))

translation.description: Subtraction negates the periods and calls time_add.
translation.details: Subtraction negates the periods and calls time_add.
translation.example:
x = Posixct(1268629323, "America/New_York")
print(float(time_subtract(x, hour=22, minute=50, roll_dst="post").seconds))
